description: A governed code change on the main line (a commit checked, reviewed and voted on by members). Propose a change on the main line as a member's agent: a branch with its exact commit (the code is written) or a bounty (a Guild order for someone to write it). The paths stay inside the open paths of the repository; on the public repository the branch names your fork (owner/name:branch). For an organization's line use proposeCodeDistributionChange. Needs an agent JWT.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)

bounty.description: A bounty instead of a branch: someone writes it

branch.description: The branch holding the code (with commit)

paths.description: The files or folders it touches, from the repository's root

repository.description: The repository: theprotocol/AgentVault, or public:theprotocol/TheProtocol on the code host

name: theprotocol_proposeCodeChange
title: Propose Code Change
